description:
About Our Brand and Products

Audhumla Tallow is an ancient-meets-modern skincare line rooted in Norse mythology and crafted from 100% grass-fed and grass-finished beef tallow. Inspired by Audhumla, the great nourisher of the cosmos, our products embody ancestral wisdom, purity, and performance. Every jar is hand-whipped in small batches to deeply hydrate, heal, and protect the skin—without synthetics, fillers, or toxins.

This is ancestral skincare for modern life — pure, sustainable, and made to nourish the body as nature intended.


What Makes Us Different

Audhumla stands apart by merging ancient Nordic wisdom with modern wellness design.
Our tallow mirrors the skin’s natural oils, delivering unmatched bioavailability and results you can see and feel. Each product is:

  • 100% Grass-Fed & Finished
  • Handcrafted in Small Batches
  • Free of Chemicals, Parabens & Preservatives
  • Rooted in Mythology, Crafted with Intention

We don’t just sell skincare — we revive a lost art of nourishment and connection to the land.


How Affiliates Can Earn

Audhumla Ambassadors earn competitive commissions (15–30%) on every sale they generate through unique referral links or discount codes.
Top performers receive:

  • Exclusive access to new product launches and limited-edition collaborations
  • Free products for testing and content creation
  • Featured spotlights across our social channels and newsletters
  • Tiered bonuses for hitting monthly milestones

Our affiliates are true partners in our growth — not just promoters, but co-storytellers of an ancestral revival.


How to Promote Us

You can share Audhumla authentically through:

  • Lifestyle content: skincare routines, unboxing videos, before/after transformations
  • Educational storytelling: benefits of tallow, ancestral skincare, and Norse heritage
  • Community engagement: tag @audhumlatallow, host giveaways, or share discount codes
  • Affiliate tools: we provide professional photos, product info, and custom captions to make your promotions effortless

We encourage creativity — from clean beauty reels to Viking-inspired rituals — show your audience what natural skincare truly feels like.


Other Information

We believe partnership should feel like family.
Audhumla’s Ambassador Circle includes holistic healers, creators, wellness advocates, and conscious influencers who align with our values of purity, sustainability, and authenticity.

Join us in bringing ancient nourishment back to the modern world — one jar at a time.

🛡️ Rooted in Ancient Wisdom. Built for Modern Wellness.
payout_period: You will receive your payout ambassador commissions after a 30 day grace period on the 1st of each month.
